The tall violet parent is DDWw, so it can only pass D (tall) but can pass either W or w for flower color.  
The dwarf white parent is ddww, so it can only pass d (dwarf) and w (white).  

For height: Dd × dd → all Dd (tall).  
For flower color: Ww × ww → 1 Ww (violet) : 1 ww (white).  

So all offspring are tall, and half violet, half white.  
Phenotypic ratio: 1 tall violet : 1 tall white.  

Final answer: (D)
